intervention_definition.e4_experiment_name: Cross-Perspective Interchangeability (Reader prompt-derived affect vector -> Self response-onset state)

first_candidate_token_validation.theoretical_justification: All 729 VAD candidates start with '{"'. The probability of this first token is determined by logits at the prompt-end position and represents an identical constant factor across all candidates in softmax comparison. Thus, injecting the difference vector at the response-onset hidden state cleanly and validly affects the subsequent sequence generation (tokens 2+) of the VAD report.
